article.story: NORMAN, Okla. -- — Xzayvier Brown scored 19 points to lead Oklahoma to an 81-72 victory over North Alabama on Monday night. B.J. Edwards added 17 points and Pop Isaacs had 13 for Oklahoma (2-1). Brown, Edwards, and Isaacs combined for 11 of the Sooners' 13 3-pointers. Derrion Reid, the Sooners’ leader in scoring (15.5) and rebounds (7.5) per game, scored 10 points and matched Brown and Isaacs with six rebounds apiece. The Sooners built a 37-36 edge at the break, and opened the second half on a 17-2 run. Ansar Osman's 3-pointer cut the Lions' deficit to 59-50 with 10:49 remaining. The Sooners then held a double-digit margin until the final basket. Mike Evbagharu scored 27 points on 10-of-11 shooting and grabbed eight rebounds for North Alabama (2-1). Quan Lax added 14 points and Jacobe Whitted chipped in with 13. Evbagharu's layup to start the second half gave North Alabama its last lead, 38-37. The Lions led just one time in the first half when Caden Harris hit a 3-pointer with 1:07 left before the break. Up next North Alabama: at No. 17 Miami on Friday. Oklahoma: hosts Fairleigh Dickinson on Friday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
